Test vectors for the eddsa-rdfc-2022 cryptosuite, copied unchanged from the W3C specification repository
https://github.com/w3c/vc-di-eddsa (folder TestVectors/ and TestVectors/eddsa-rdfc-2022/), used under the
W3C Software and Document License. `tests/unit/open-badges.test.ts` checks that SkillPass produces exactly
these intermediate values and this proof.
